name: Takasu Yoshika
source:
The main character and his cousin are the public relations staff of Nobilis Aquila Corporation, a major foreign-affiliated online shopping company. She always takes care of Takashi to an excessive degree, which is a little annoying to him at his age. Yoshika also represents the company on TV and the internet, since she is responsible for the Public Relations (PR) of the company she seems to have built quite the fanbase.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1139363]Getchu[/url]]
